marie: Uploaded a refreshed launch blog draft + slim benchmark appendix. Need copy lock by Thu EOD so design can ship hero and we can finalize the webinar invite. Pls quick review. :running:

noah: skimmed. One tone nit and one compliance flag on line 45 (phrase: 'ironclad isolation').

anya: I can swap tone. Recommend we use 'enterprise-grade isolation' instead.

sam: For webinar routing, propose: 
``nTop CTA: Try it free -> no form
Mid CTA: Request demo -> HubSpot form 55100 -> list Demo_Queue_Apr26
Footer CTA: Register webinar -> HubSpot form 55199 -> list Webinar_Launch_Apr
Email follow-up tag: source=launch_blog
``nWhich HubSpot owners?

marie: @sam please route demo leads to SDR_Inbound and add property 'campaign: launch_apr_2026'. Webinar regs -> Marketing_Nurture.

legal-bot: Auto-scan: phrase flagged: 'ironclad isolation'. Replace or attach compliance link. Suggested replacement: 'enterprise-grade controls'.

noah: agreed. change to 'enterprise-grade controls' + cite https://redwood.com/compliance/soc2

anya: swapped and pushed edits. Also tightened subhead to: 'Predictable, cost-efficient inference'.

sam: Added HubSpot mapping in the doc. Will create workflows after copy lock.

marie: Copy lock checklist: (1) legal cleared phrasing, (2) benchmark appendix included, (3) CTA mapping + HubSpot form ids. Who final approves?

noah: I'll sign off once legal-bot clears.

legal-bot: Re-scan scheduled. Will post status in 2h.
